content_sections.heading: Hathras Anganwadi Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female (women) candidates are eligible to apply for both Karyakatri and Sahayika posts. The applicant must be a resident of the same Ward/Gram Sabha where the vacancy exists. If no eligible candidate is available in that Gram Sabha, selection will be made from eligible candidates of the concerned Nyay Panchayat. Selection follows a defined priority order among women candidates of the same Gram Sabha/Ward: Widowed, legally divorced, or abandoned woman from a BPL (Below Poverty Line) family If unavailable - any woman from a BPL family (general) If unavailable - widowed/divorced/abandoned woman from an above-BPL family If unavailable - any woman from an above-BPL family (general) If no eligible candidate is found in any of the above categories within the Gram Sabha, the same priority order is applied at the Nyay Panchayat level.

content_sections.heading: Hathras Anganwadi Qualification
content_sections.text: Minimum qualification: Intermediate (12th) or equivalent. Maximum qualification considered for merit: Postgraduate degree. Applicants must enter marks obtained in all their qualifying exams (Intermediate, Graduation, and Postgraduate, as applicable) in the online form; the merit list is prepared by combining these marks.

content_sections.heading: Hathras Anganwadi Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 35 years Cut-off date for maximum age: 01-07-2026 Date of birth as recorded in the High School marksheet/certificate is treated as valid. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: Hathras Anganwadi Selection Process
content_sections.text: A merit list is prepared by adding marks obtained in Intermediate, Graduation, and Postgraduate examinations, as applicable. Tie-breaker 1: If two or more candidates score equal marks, the candidate with higher age gets preference. Tie-breaker 2: If marks and age are also equal, the candidate with higher educational qualification gets preference. Reservation for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, and Other Backward Class candidates is applied as per applicable government orders. Applications for a reserved post are valid only from candidates of that category; unreserved posts accept candidates from any category.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hathras Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: upanganwadibharti.in Find the relevant vacant Anganwadi Kendra/post listed project-wise. Fill the online application form carefully and correctly within the prescribed window. Upload self-attested, clear, and legible scanned copies of required documents matching the details entered online. Submit the form before the last date. Offline or postal applications/documents are not accepted. Any error, incorrect facts/figures, or tampered/fake documents will lead to rejection of the application, per the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the Hathras UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is being conducted by Hathras UP Anganwadi to fill various contract-based positions across the district through an online application process.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in Hathras UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 252 vacancies available under this recruitment notification for posts including Anganwadi Worker and Sahayika.

faq.question: Q3. What are the key positions offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The prominent posts advertised in this notification are Anganwadi Worker and Sahayika, with varying vacancy distributions for each category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the start date for online applications?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 23-09-2026, allowing eligible candidates to submit their forms through the portal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for Hathras UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The final date to successfully submit your online application form is 13-10-2026. Candidates must complete submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for these posts must possess Intermediate (12th) or equivalent qualification from a recognized board or institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age of the candidates must be between 18 years and 35 years as per the guidelines specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on a merit list calculated from marks obtained in Intermediate, Graduation, and Post Graduation examinations.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for the Hathras UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website at http://upanganwadibharti.in and completing the necessary application steps.
